author: sylvainpoux
body:
Hi GO,
 
An user pointed out that 2 subcellular locations in UniProt (subcell.txt) are missing mapping to GO
 
Would it be possible to link 
Cytoplasmic vesicle to GO:0031410 cytoplasmic vesicle
Extracellular vesicle TO GO:1903561 extracellular vesicle
 
Thanks
 
Sylvain
 
ID   Cytoplasmic vesicle.
AC   SL-0088
DE   The cytoplasmic vesicles mediate vesicular transport among the
DE   organelles of secretory and endocytic systems. These transport
DE   vesicles are classified by the identity of the protein coat used in
DE   their formation and also by the cargo they contain, e.g. clathrin-,
DE   COPI-, and COPII-coated vesicles, synaptic vesicles, secretory
DE   vesicles, phagosomes, etc.
SL   Cytoplasmic vesicle.
HI   Vesicle.
KW   KW-0968
OB   No
 
ID   Extracellular vesicle.
AC   SL-0499
DE   Extracellular vesicles are vesicles that have been released by cells.
SY   Microparticle.
SL   Extracellular vesicle.
HI   Vesicle.
RX   PubMed=24769233; DOI=10.1016/j.jprot.2014.04.028;
OB   No
